final_message:
Configured the 49 authoritative zones on pc1–pc49, including all 48 delegations and their glue records. The four requested MX records use priority 10 and point to the existing addresses of their assigned PCs.

pc50 is the recursive resolver at `10.16.13.12`; all PCs are configured to use it. The existing topology, addresses, and routes were left unchanged. Usage and example queries are in [DNS-README.md](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-7te7o5yx/lab/DNS-README.md).

I verified the zone assignments, delegation glue, and startup script syntax. I could not run the lab or test live DNS queries because Docker access was denied; the configuration also depends on the existing `kathara/base` image providing BIND 9’s `named` executable.
